intent: On each pass the ground loop writes a record in its own device space (~/.cairn/devices/ground_loop/<instance>/) carrying: when it last ran, its state, and its pid. The write is part of the pass, not a separate concern.
why: The foundation the other three children read. It is also the first device record ever to reach disk in Cairn — the runtime-spine sweep measured ZERO. That makes it layer 0 of that sweep's map and this ticket at the same time: a scan-and-post loop that finds nothing produces no output, so without this record 'ran and found nothing' and 'never ran' are the same observation from outside.
falsifier: The record's last-run does not advance while the loop runs, or advances while it does not. And: the record must survive being read mid-write (a reader must never see a torn record) — atomic write, same discipline as the projector's append door.

BUILDME.need: the ground loop rebuilt to Akien's 2026-07-30 ruling (scans each device's ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/groundloop/ each beat and posts to the bus on a met trigger). Akien: 'once this is done, the very next intention is...' — this whole family sits downstream of that. decisions/2026-07-30-the-ground-loop-scans-disk-and-posts-to-the-bus.json

watchme: none, because its falsifier is mechanical and a proof settles it — advance the loop, read the file from a SEPARATE process, assert the stamp moved. The question that needs time (what staleness threshold is honest) belongs to the parent, which carries the watch.
cursor_correction_2026-07-30: Cast with the cursor at [BUILDME], corrected to [THINKME] within the hour. A cursor AT a stage means that stage was ENTERED — superclaude-starts-itself rests at [PROVEME] with its BUILDME gate already satisfied — so [BUILDME] on a freshly cast leaf claims a crossing that never rode the chokepoint. It cannot have: since ticket buildme-rides-the-chart (2026-07-29) the entry gate refuses a BUILDME crossing unless a berthed validate packet claims the ticket, and a census of all 89 berths finds ZERO claiming any ticket in this family. Hand-writing the cursor forward is precisely the hand-edit of a record of truth that transitions.emit exists to prevent (Law 4). The stage is reachable only by /chart, then the door.
